regeln.text: Every delivery gets a version following the project's scheme (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH), entered with `amw release version`.
regeln.erfahrung: Without entered versions it was no longer possible to say later what had been delivered when – in one review, two out of three projects had not entered a single one.

regeln.text: A task is done only with evidence (commit, file:line or document), one sentence on what was done, and its kind (new, improved, fixed, internal).
regeln.erfahrung: In a trial, the release notes could be compiled from evidence and one sentence per task without anyone having to rework them.

regeln.text: Task from your own list → own branch → check it yourself → review request with the exact state (commit) and the list of checks → the lead's OK → merge, enter the version. New state = new review.
regeln.warum: A review only says something about exactly the state that was reviewed. Every change after it is unreviewed – even a small one.

regeln.text: Show something small early (picture, number, draft, first commit), then build out.
regeln.erfahrung: Drafts and pictures before building revealed deviations from what was wanted before anything was built. A draft costs minutes, a rebuild costs days.

regeln.text: Whoever waits (for a review, an approval, the human) says what for and takes the next task. Work without a reason to wait always comes before waiting.
regeln.warum: Whoever waits silently stands still – and nobody knows what for. A named reason to wait can be worked off.

regeln.text: File reports, pictures and drafts as a document (with a title and a link to the task), never loose in folders.
regeln.warum: What only lies in a folder is not found again by the next session; in the AMW it has a title, a version and a link to the task.

regeln.text: Measure or look first, then say; mark an assumption as an assumption; explicitly retract an error.
regeln.erfahrung: A measurement taken too early was reported as a finding and had to be retracted. A wrong finding costs more than a missing one.

regeln.text: Ask the human only when decisions, rules, verbatim records and code do not answer the question – then with options, a recommendation and a reason.
regeln.warum: Every question costs the human time. What has been decided is in the decisions, rules and verbatim records – looking there is faster than asking.

regeln.text: Their statements are recorded verbatim, never rephrased or passed on second-hand as their word. Decisions are recorded as a decision with a source; rules change only through a decision.
regeln.warum: Passing on and shortening shifts the meaning. Only the verbatim record shows what was said; only a decision with a source shows what applies.

regeln.text: Scope, values and appearance are decided by the human. Whatever goes beyond the assignment is proposed as a follow-up task, not built along.
regeln.warum: What nobody ordered still has to be reviewed, maintained and, in doubt, removed again. A proposal costs nothing.

regeln.titel: Two on the same spot talk first
regeln.text: Clarify beforehand who takes it – no double fixes.
regeln.warum: Two solutions for the same spot have to be merged – that usually takes longer than agreeing beforehand.

regeln.titel: The lead leads, the human decides
regeln.text: The lead plans, assigns, reviews and approves within their scope; approvals with outside effect (publishing, costs, deleting, schema) are given only by the human.
regeln.warum: Without clear responsibility either nobody approves or two do. What has outside effect or cannot be undone is decided by whoever answers for it.

regeln.text: Passwords, keys, tokens and access identifiers never go into the database, repository, messages or documents – only into local files outside.
regeln.warum: A secret published once is burnt, even if it is deleted again at once – it has to be replaced.

regeln.titel: Deleting and foreign processes: the human only
regeln.text: Agents archive instead of deleting (with a log old → new) and end only their own processes; a foreign hang is reported.
regeln.warum: Deleting cannot be undone, and an agent cannot know for sure whether a folder or process really belongs to nobody any more.

regeln.text: No push, no release without a green review on exactly this state and the lead's OK; commit only explicitly named files; delete no branches, force nothing.
regeln.erfahrung: An “add everything” took along files that did not belong in the public repository.

regeln.text: Screen, graphics card and heavy computation only through the run queue: wait for the release first, then start.
regeln.warum: There is only one screen and one graphics card. Two runs at once disturb each other and devalue both results.

regeln.titel: Back up before changing data or schema
regeln.text: Back up first, then rehearse on a copy; schema changes only on the human's word.
regeln.erfahrung: A database migration starts at once for everyone who opens the database – without a backup there would be no way back.

regeln.text: What, when, consequence, fix – your own too, small ones too. Do not conceal, do not play down.
regeln.warum: A reported error can be fixed and becomes a rule; a concealed one is repeated.

regeln.text: Everyone finishes one piece before starting the next. New things go to the inbox and are planned behind the running piece; if the running piece waits for a reason, the next may start. Only the human decides to put something first.
regeln.erfahrung: When new wishes were passed straight to an agent who was working, half-finished states, stacked branches and messy merges followed.

regeln.text: No names of people, customers or internal matters in the repository, docs, pictures or commit details.
regeln.erfahrung: Names in a public changelog and in the details of a commit had to be removed afterwards.

regeln.titel: Third-party software and models only when cleared
regeln.text: Only from official sources, with a licence that permits the use; free licences are cleared by the lead, everything else by the human.
regeln.warum: Whether software or a model may be used is stated in the licence – that has to be clear before anything builds on it.

regeln.titel: Windowed runs only when the screen is free
regeln.text: Runs that open windows only when the human has released the screen.
regeln.warum: A run with a window takes over mouse and keyboard. If someone is working at the machine, that disturbs both.

regeln.titel: Check-ins for a lead working as a chat
regeln.text: At the end of every check-in, create a new one-off reminder (short neutral text – the content is in the AMW). Leave expired reminders or delete them. Never change an existing reminder and never switch it to “recurring” – delete it and create a new one instead. The interval is set by the project (default every 2 hours; in between the human nudges when needed).
regeln.erfahrung: Verified: creating and deleting a reminder works without a prompt; every change to an existing one requires a click by the human – the check-ins then stop until someone clicks.
